title: Nutty Venezuelan Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich and creamy dessert featuring dark chocolate and nuts, perfect for a weeknight treat. This low-fat friendly recipe is slow-cooked to perfection in a traditional molcajete.
instructions: Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks.
In another bowl, mix together the sugar, pecans, vanilla extract, and salt.
Fold the sugar mixture into the melted chocolate until well combined.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until they form stiff peaks.
Fold the egg whites into the chocolate mixture until no white streaks remain.
Stir in the water and mix until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a molcajete or individual serving cups.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until set.
Serve chilled and garnished with additional pecans if desired.
